notes.title: 12.25Update：Easy mode added
notes.notes:
1.The easy mode added：You can get 3 HP on start of levels or touch checkpoint.If you want play with the easy mode, please restart the newgame.

2.Fixed the volume bug:after the update,please turn the volume up to the maximum  and back to main menu,then enter the volume options again .
